# Source evidence

The 197 chapter inventory comes from the official Rust by Example SUMMARY.md. The extracted/ files preserve web-tool text extracts from official rendered pages, retrieved 2026-11-12. These are not raw Markdown and may have web extraction artifacts; do not use them as compilable source code. A single immutable upstream commit could not be retrieved because shell DNS and uncached web requests were unavailable. sourceCommit is therefore null. Local SHA-256 hashes only identify the exact saved extracts, not upstream commit provenance.

The Thai text and application examples are an independently authored concise adaptation following every topic, not a word-for-word full translation. Supplemental API/error-code references are listed in supplemental-references.json; their saved extracts live under supplemental/.

Rust by Example is MIT OR Apache-2.0. This adaptation retains the MIT license notice under rust-by-example/LICENSE-MIT. Source and license URLs are recorded in source-manifest.json. The upstream authors are Jorge Aparicio and Rust project contributors.
